cycles.kind: One independent published RCT Pickal 2026, 427 five-arm sample vs 345 motivation cases, 82 not in ANOVA. Unidentified full-arm contrast bounds conditional, not causal novelty.
Palikot 2026 randomized school bundled treatment; 4 vs 12 week original published aggregate activity/volume decomposition, no post-treatment causal mechanism claims.

Direct independent 2024 randomized offer of leaderboard versus none; N3762 eligible, five outcome B/SE table; 8/8 tests show single vs 5-family CI discrepancy at illustrative 0.05 SD; post-allocation dispersion not causal.

C03 original Kloc randomized direct leaderboard offer reported no statistically discernible five-engagement benefit; 95% CI upper +.040 SD, conservative 5-endpoint familywise upper +.0502 SD exceeds illustrative 0.05 benchmark; cannot assert equivalence or positive effect.
Kloc paper's intra-board dispersion association is not identical to random offer effect; 3,762 eligible ≠ verified all-registrant ITT.
C04 deterministic winner-take-all quadratic ranking not incentive-compatible in exact p=.55 q=.60 case: rational r=.61 improves win probability by .10 despite worse expected quadratic score.

C05 STOP_R5: strong existing original prior art on public rank welfare, social-learning accuracy-risk, GJP ranking and strategy-proof forecast prizes. Neither consent/ethics nor legal access to eligible full randomized human roster available.

New 2026 original Agranov RCT already isolates others' actions from common public raw signals: social-action visibility not an original untested mechanism; observed positive task effect does not generalize to PFL.
New 2026 original Xu randomized relative-rank reference group: comparison-group welfare heterogeneity not original; actual replication package rights and admin person rows not verified.
AEA Feb 2026 policy allows non-public confidential replication data. A 'replication package' label cannot authorize access nor prove assignment/eligibility/exposure records.
C05 initial native Node test 8/12 then fail on duplicate-question accounting, before holdouts. Repair separately preregistered and frozen; final 12/12 PASS. Not a second cycle.

Original ForecastBench 2×500 public real questions have 250 nonprobability raw-quantity source records per cohort, despite numeric scalar freeze values sometimes within [0,1]; forbids naive Brier across all sources.
Original 2026-09-27 and 10-11 cohorts only yield 52+8 qualifying resolved market questions, so descriptive market Brier scores are subject to resolution selection and cannot be attributed to PFL.
